items.exampleEn: Gambling means playing games of chance for money.
items.exampleZh: 賭博是指拿錢玩靠運氣決定輸贏的遊戲。

items.exampleEn: He sailed solo across the ocean in a small boat.
items.exampleZh: 他獨自駕著小船橫渡大洋。

items.exampleEn: The children recited a short verse at the start of the school day.
items.exampleZh: 孩子們在上學日開始時朗誦一小段詩句。

items.exampleEn: The melody of this song is so simple that even small children can sing it.
items.exampleZh: 這首歌的旋律簡單到連小孩子都會唱。

items.exampleEn: Her favorite fictional character is a brave little mouse.
items.exampleZh: 她最喜歡的虛構角色是一隻勇敢的小老鼠。

items.exampleEn: Three old friends formed a comedy trio, and now they have their own radio show.
items.exampleZh: 三個老朋友組成喜劇三人組，現在有了自己的廣播節目。

items.exampleEn: The ballet company is performing a new show this winter.
items.exampleZh: 那個芭蕾舞團今年冬天要演出新的作品。

items.exampleEn: There is a small statue of a dwarf with a red hat in the garden.
items.exampleZh: 花園裡有一尊戴紅帽子的小矮人雕像。

items.exampleEn: Most novels are written in prose, not in verse.
items.exampleZh: 大多數小說是用散文寫的，而不是韻文。

items.sentenceEn: My little sister has been taking ballet lessons since she was five.
items.sentenceZh: 我妹妹從五歲開始上芭蕾舞課。

items.audioEn: In the second half of the concert, the guitarist will play a solo piece he wrote himself.
items.audioZh: 音樂會下半場，吉他手會獨奏一首他自己寫的曲子。
items.questionZh: 吉他手下半場會做什麼？
options: Sing a song with the band

items.sentenceEn: In the old novel, a rich man loses his house because of gambling.
items.sentenceZh: 在那本老小說裡，一個有錢人因為賭博而失去了房子。

items.sentenceEn: I remember the melody, but I've forgotten the name of the song.
items.sentenceZh: 我記得旋律，但忘了這首歌叫什麼。

items.stemEn: The jazz ____ is made up of a piano player, a drummer and a singer.
items.stemZh: 這個爵士三重奏由一位鋼琴手、一位鼓手和一位歌手組成。

items.stemEn: None of the people in this novel really lived; they are all ____.
items.stemZh: 這本小說裡的人物都不曾真的存在，全都是虛構的。

items.passageEn: Our school's arts night was a big success. Under soft lighting, it opened with a short ballet performed by the dance club. Next, a trio of students played a soft melody on the violin, cello and piano. Then my friend sang a solo, and the whole hall joined in for the last verse. In the second half, the writing club read their work: some wrote poems, and others wrote prose about fictional towns and a family of dwarfs living under a tree. The evening ended with a funny play about a legendary detective.
items.passageZh: 我們學校的藝術之夜非常成功。在柔和的燈光下，開場是舞蹈社演出的一小段芭蕾。接著，三位同學以小提琴、大提琴和鋼琴演奏了一段柔和的旋律。然後我朋友獨唱，最後一段主歌全場都跟著一起唱。下半場，寫作社朗讀他們的作品：有人寫詩，有人寫散文，描寫虛構的小鎮，以及住在樹下的一家小矮人。晚會最後是一齣關於傳奇偵探的爆笑短劇。

questions.questionZh: 藝術之夜的開場節目是什麼？
寫作社的散文寫了什麼？

items.promptZh: 這首歌的第二段主歌是我最喜歡的部分。
referenceEn: The second verse of this song is my favorite part.
My favorite part of this song is the second verse.
rubricZh: verse 指歌曲的「主歌、段」（例如 the second verse）
「最喜歡的部分」可寫，例如 my favorite part 等

items.promptZh: 她的文筆簡單卻很優美。
referenceEn: Her prose is simple but very beautiful.
She writes prose that is simple but beautiful.
rubricZh: prose 這裡指「文筆、散文」，不可數（例如 Her prose is…、writes … prose 等）
「簡單卻優美」可寫，例如 simple but beautiful、simple yet lovely 等
時態可用現在式或過去式
